text: Program Description Main Courses There are four language classes. The main contents are included listening, reading, writing and conversation. Course Arrangement Class begins at 8:00am every weekday morning and goes until 12:20pm most days, giving you the afternoon to study or explore the city. Semester starting and finishing dates are different to that most universities. Extracurricular Activities During the semester the foreign office organises outings and sporting events for your class and other foreign students to keep your mind refreshed and your time in China memerable. Some of these evensts include Jump rope competitions, tug-a-war competitions, class picnics and trips to special plays or events. The foreign sector of the univiserity allocates a small amount of money to each student for these events. Once this money runs out you may have to pay for excursions out of your own money, however it is never an expensive occasion.
